description: This Java source file defines the LogFragment class, which is a fragment that displays log messages within a ScrollView and LogView, supporting dynamic log output and user interaction.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment class that manages a LogView inside a ScrollView to display log messages, with methods to create views and handle text changes.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and sets up the ScrollView and LogView, applies styling, and returns the ScrollView containing the LogView.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Initializes the view hierarchy for the fragment, adds a text change listener to auto-scroll on new log entries, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used in the fragment for log output.
